blocks.text: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia — The Malaysian Palm Oil Council (MPOC) sees room to expand its presence in the Philippines, particularly through oleochemicals and other high-value products, its official said. MPOC CEO Belvinder Sron said the industry group could leverage the country’s oleochemical sector to manufacture consumer goods such as laundry detergents, soaps, and personal-care items using palm oil. READ: Malaysia sees higher palm oil exports to PH “There’s still a lot of potential to expand the usage of palm oil, and this is something that the MPOC has been focusing on,” Sron said on the sidelines of the Malaysian Palm Oil Forum.
